assumptions.battery_rail: SRC-BATTERY:11.2V end-of-discharge,14.4V upper charge. Nominal HUB bus12V is a reference, not measured regulation or transient bound.
assumptions.converter: SRC-SD50:9.2..18V,50W,10A,70% typical. Adjust5.1V only after qualification. Assumed50% available-power factor is a sensitivity input, not a read-off approved derating curve.
assumptions.hub_loads: ALL STATE CURRENTS ASSUMED. Pi-only allocations exclude separately listed USB load. USB1.2A aggregate provisional allocation requires official limit/revision confirmation. DAQ/storage placeholder draw is inside USB; wet camera terminal power is separate and calculated tether copper/contact loss at minimum battery voltage is added to the HUB input budget. No modem/gateway/lighting/heater/array/wiper/projector load included; these missing loads block final sizing.
assumptions.inrush: Capacitance4700uF,10ms linear voltage ramp, simultaneous startup, no active limiter are assumptions. Converter input capacitance/inrush is absent from retrieved datasheet. Capacitor ramp current is not an actual hot-plug peak bound.
assumptions.reef_loads: Whole ESP DevKit and interface currents are assumed, not chip deep-sleep data. Dedicated3.3V radio converter candidate is unselected; do not draw it from DevKit3V3.120mA radio burst allocation exceeds vendor87mA operating point but is not a measured maximum. MPPT19mA at12V is vendor load-on data; BMS0.1W and converter efficiencies are assumptions.
assumptions.reserve: SRC-BATTERY12.8V50Ah at25C.0.8DoD,0.8aged capacity,0.8cold capacity (vendor0C value),0.9discharge path efficiency and3days requested reserve are scenarios, not warranted lifetime/autonomy. Reserve applies to one REEF; HUB-on-same-battery is a separate illustration. Charging at0C is prohibited by candidate battery despite modeled discharge capacity.
assumptions.solar: SRC-PANEL40W STC,Voc22.45,Isc2.4,betaVoc-0.0035/C.1peak-sun-hour/day,0.65field derate,0.9charge efficiency and0.9discharge-path efficiency from reserve model (all solar energy conservatively cycles through storage before load-side comparison),1.25Isc factor,-10C cold cell and70C hot cell are sensitivity assumptions, not site data.40W model not suitable by mere catalog wattage.
assumptions.tether: 25m one-way,0.75mm2 copper,40C,50mohm total contacts are examples only; not site cable/USB transport selections. Copper resistivity0.0175ohm mm2/m at20C and coefficient0.00393/C are handbook-level modeling assumptions.9..16V camera input range is not a vendor rating.
assumptions.thermal: 35C shaded ambient,1.5K/W enclosure-to-air resistance and0.12m2 solar area/800Wm2/0.5absorptivity are assumed. All Pi/USB and DC/DC loss heat stays in HUB, camera power leaves enclosure. No measured thermal resistance or junction model; Pi50C is ambient limit, not junction.

inrush.qualification: unmeasured; does not bound hot-plug parasitic/ESR peaks or select a fuse

open_gates: USB-C source/OVP/current limit/cable/Pi revision and full USB limit verification
Independent REEF5V/3V3 regulators and radio burst/backpower measurement
External Smart battery BMS, charger/load disconnect and temperature protection
Actual load states including missing gateway/backhaul/heater/lighting if needed
Thermal path, enclosure, shading and measured ambient/junction rise
Solar season/shading and hot-panel startup/charge compatibility
Optional physical output absent; safety hardware and all electrical/acoustic qualification open

solar.energy_boundary: load-side; all harvested energy modeled through storage cycle
solar.qualification: site yield not measured; hot Voc startup is necessary not sufficient; BMS/charger interaction open

tether.unmodeled: transients, wet insulation/leakage, signal transport, startup/control stability

thermal.qualification: lumped steady-state screen only; no measured internal air/junction or marine thermal evidence
